{"topic": "homelab", "title": "Container down:{{#ctx.results.0.aggregations.down.buckets}} {{key}}{{/ctx.results.0.aggregations.down.buckets}}", "message": "{{#ctx.results.0.aggregations.down.buckets}}{{key}} died at {{dies.et.hits.hits.0.fields.et.0}} with exit code{{#dies.exit.buckets}} {{key}}{{/dies.exit.buckets}} and did NOT come back within 3 min.
{{/ctx.results.0.aggregations.down.buckets}}Exit codes: 137 = SIGKILL (OOM-kill or docker kill), 143 = SIGTERM (docker stop), 0 = exited cleanly, 1/2 = the app crashed, -1 = not recorded.
Likely cause: it crashed and nothing restarted it (restart policy 'no', or on-failure gave up), or someone ran docker stop / compose stop and left it.
Do: docker ps -a --filter name=<container>; docker logs --tail 100 <container>; then docker compose up -d <service> if it should be running.

{"topic": "homelab", "title": "Crash loop:{{#ctx.results.0.aggregations.loop.buckets}} {{key}}{{/ctx.results.0.aggregations.loop.buckets}}", "message": "{{#ctx.results.0.aggregations.loop.buckets}}{{key}} has died {{dies.doc_count}} times in 15 min (last at {{dies.et.hits.hits.0.fields.et.0}}, exit code{{#dies.exit.buckets}} {{key}}{{/dies.exit.buckets}}) - it is crash-looping: Docker keeps restarting it and it keeps exiting.
{{/ctx.results.0.aggregations.loop.buckets}}Gated alerts (5xx, error rate, healthcheck) are NOT treated as deploy noise while this lasts.
Likely cause: the app fails at startup (bad config or env, a dependency or DB it needs is down, a failed migration, a bad new image from Watchtower).
Do: docker logs --tail 100 <container> (the reason is usually in the last lines); docker ps -a --filter name=<container>; if a new image broke it, pin the previous digest and docker compose up -d <service>.

ui_metadata.description: A compose-managed container OOMed, died and did not start again within 3 min, or died 3+ times in 15 min (crash loop). Compose one-offs (docker compose run), scratch/test/auto-named containers and the tallied-demo/tasks-demo reseed cron are ignored.
